about: How each prepared training set that the model recipes read was produced: the script, its settings, what it was built from, and which earlier models' weights it depends on. Traced from manifests, receipts and the scripts themselves. 'command_recorded' says whether the exact command line was written down at the time; where it was not, 'command' is reconstructed from the script's arguments. Scripts are paths in this repository. Folders are where the files sat on the machine that trained the models; they are not in Git.

recordings.what: Simulated scenes with sinusoidal forcing on four grid shapes at 8 and 16 cells per metre; every output step kept.
recordings.dataset: sinusoidal-v1 (surrogate/datasets); regenerate with python -m surrogate.datasets generate sinusoidal-v1

recordings.what: Simulated scenes with scheduled forcing at six cell densities; only short windows of steps were kept.
Thirty-six 20-second scenes at 240 solver updates per second; selected steps kept. Twenty-four are training scenes.
recordings.notes: Not yet a surrogate/datasets definition. Most loose state files were written to /tmp and are gone; the 24 training scenes survive inside the packed archive (see long-training-archive). Several of the capture settings files (pilot 01, shards 03 to 08) no longer exist.

recordings.what: The pressure-era water scenes: 256 train, 64 validation and 64 reserved parents, plus three later cohorts.
recordings.notes: The exact generate and pack commands were not recorded; the README of experiments/sealed-water-v1 gives the sequence.

recordings.what: Variable-shape pressure scenes with cubic cells at several densities.
recordings.notes: Command lines were not recorded. Scene seeds are in the study config (510000 and up).

recordings.what: Larger-grid pressure scenes added by the pressure-methods studies.
recordings.notes: The solver builds these scripts make live under runs/ and start from the lab's Rheon worktree, which is now branch lab/reference-solver-v1 of the Rheon repository (its first two commits).

training_sets.what: One validation frame used as a fixed probe by the typed pressure runs.
training_sets.command: a direct call of consumed_validation_probe with runs/water-early-pressure-v1/control/project, as the tests in test_typed_pressure_workflow.py do
training_sets.notes: Also reads the receipts of that project's completed training run.

training_sets.what: The 16 train parents of the water-early-pressure control project, re-keyed, with its direction bank.
training_sets.notes: Needs a selection file that was kept under runs/. Projects 3 and 6 have identical data.

training_sets.what: Early and late correction states produced by running a trained pressure model on the training scenes.
training_sets.command: prepare.py into preparation-02, then freeze_bank.py --root . --preparation runs/pressure-current-policy-v1/preparation-02 --output runs/pressure-current-policy-v1/bank-02
needs_models: the weight003 model of pressure-feedback-weight-ablation-v1 (itself trained on dependency-training-inputs)

training_sets.what: All 129 states of the 16 sinusoidal training scenes, packed losslessly, with one scale each for pressure, velocity and tracer.
training_sets.command: pack_temporal.py then finish_temporal_view.py; neither takes arguments
training_sets.notes: No randomness. The packing step stopped at its own size limit after writing the archive and the finish step completed the view. Rebuildable from the dataset alone.

training_sets.what: 34 pressure parents: the v2 shape view plus 8 larger scenes.
training_sets.notes: Training rebuilds part of each sample on load with experiments/pressure-methods-v3/native_reconstruct.py and experiments/pressure-methods-v1/numerics.py.

training_sets.what: 26 pressure parents: the v1 domain view plus 6 new shapes.
training_sets.notes: The v3 replay view is a byte copy of this view with two manifest fields changed; no script that made the copy was found.

training_sets.what: 20 pressure parents: the 16 small-grid water parents plus 4 large-grid scenes.
Variants of the 16 water parents at other cell spacings and with finer-timestep teacher solutions.
The v3 derived view plus 8 diverse scenes, or plus 4 scenes visited by a trained model's own rollout.
needs_models: the v3-native model, for the on-policy view only

training_sets.what: The v3 derived view plus 12 manufactured pressure patterns.
training_sets.notes: The manufactured patterns are seeded from docs/plans/pressure-methods-v5/scene-reservation.json.

training_sets.what: Per-trial copies of a shared water training view; 55 trial folders across 14 water studies.
training_sets.command: pipeline.py assemble with the trial's config; each project's source-witness.json names the Git commit of the assembler and config that ran
training_sets.command_recorded_in: per study: docs/plans/<study>/reports/ (assemble-*-execution.json, capture.json, commands.md, methods.md)
training_sets.notes: The data files in every project are byte copies of the view named above. Studies with direction inputs also read direction-banks.

training_sets.what: Early and late correction directions computed by running a trained model; read as direction_dataset.npz by the early-pressure, pressure-recovery and late-residual trials and copied into dependency-training-inputs.
The first water baseline: byte copies of the train/validation and reserved packets.
training_sets.command: pipeline.py assemble, as in the README of experiments/sealed-water-v1

training_sets.what: The variable-shape pressure packets.
training_sets.notes: The variable-pressure assemble functions have no command line and the call was not recorded.

training_sets.what: Velocities from temporal-training-view-02 with the pressure right-hand side of the same states.
Synthetic inputs with labels from a formula; no simulated scenes.
training_sets.command: each script with no arguments, or --output <folder>
training_sets.notes: All seeded. The flux and point teachers also check themselves against a small solver build.

training_sets.what: Synthetic velocity fields with viscosity labels from a small solver build.
Starting inventories, normalisation and remapped weights taken from an earlier model.
Pressure and right-hand side of the 16 sinusoidal training scenes at every sixteenth state.
The spectral view re-encoded around the learned pressure gains of the previous model in the series.
needs_models: modal-pressure-pair-01, modal-precision-pair-02 and decoder-modal-pair-09 in turn

training_sets.what: Sampled points from the 16 sinusoidal training scenes at every sixteenth state.
needs_models: b1-fixed-viscosity (its point weights are an input feature)

training_sets.what: Pressure and right-hand side of all 148 diversity training scenes at eight states.
training_sets.notes: Seeded. Pins the system FFTW library by fingerprint.

training_sets.what: 783 samples from the 148 diversity training scenes with features and future labels; labels for the 29 eight-substep scenes come from two earlier models.
Current states of the 29 eight-substep scenes packed with the weights of four earlier models, from which the trainer regenerates its labels.
needs_models: internal-residual s1 and s3, for the s3 and s4 data
training_sets.notes: No script that wrote the s3 and s4 data files was found; each is the compact-source settings plus the previous stage's weights.

training_sets.what: Readout features from a frozen pair of earlier models with the next recorded state as target, for all 148 diversity training scenes.
The 24 long training scenes packed losslessly (fields.zip, 2.8 GB), and the project files the two guided models were trained from.
training_sets.command: pack_long_training_candidate_v1.py --protocol <transport settings> --output runs/full-ai-data-diversity-v1/long-training-transport-01; then each project script with --protocol <its settings file>
needs_models: mixed-modal-pair-11 (their weights are in the model-source package)
training_sets.notes: The archive was written to /tmp and the loose copy is gone; the same bytes are kept in the Tuldok project's store on the machine that trained the models.

not_training_data.what: Weights a run started from: an earlier model's weights, sometimes remapped to a new architecture first. Where the file is byte-identical to an earlier model's output the recipe names that model in from_model.
The list of files in the Python environment the run used, written by Tuldok.
